name: Khao Yai Lam Takong Camp
description: A spacious and popular camping site located beside a scenic reservoir inside Thailand's first national park. Perfect for wildlife watching and relaxing under the stars.

name: Doi Inthanon Dong Son Camp
description: Experience chilly nights nestled among pine trees near the highest peak in Thailand. Offers easy access to stunning waterfalls, royal pagodas, and nature trails.

name: Ban Krang Camp Kaeng Krachan
description: Deep inside Thailand's largest national park, this campground is world-renowned for bird and butterfly watching right from your tent.

name: Phu Kradueng Wang Kwang Camp
description: Located on top of a bell-shaped mountain plateau. Accessible only by a strenuous hike, but rewards campers with sprawling pine forests, red maple leaves, and breathtaking sunrises.

name: Erawan Riverside Campground
description: Sleep to the sound of flowing water at this lush campground, located just a short walk from the iconic, seven-tiered emerald-green Erawan waterfalls.
